notes: Direct curl_cffi HTTP fetch worked for every URL (no WAF), consistent with prior Home-Decor pass notes for SR59. robots.txt explicitly Allows Anthropic-AI (no Claude disallow). No single top-level 'Bestsellers' hub page exists (tried /uk/c/bestsellers, /uk/c/best-sellers, /uk/c/all-bestsellers - all 404); the site instead exposes 8 department-scoped Bestsellers nodes found via uk/sitemap_Category.xml keyword sweep for 'bestsell'. Checked main nav/homepage and sitemap_CategoryLanding.xml for an umbrella Bestsellers page - none found, so no parent/grouping row was invented; the 7 kept rows are siblings, each its own genuine site-defined listing (mirrors the Rule 0.6 sibling-overlap precedent from the prior Home-Decor pass on this same site, e.g. Lighting + Ceiling Lights + Table Lamps). Dropped Baby-and-Children/c/little-white-bestsellers (SSR initialItems=[], 0 products, confirmed empty) per the zero-product-listing rule. Counts came from the site's own server-rendered 'initialItems' JSON blob (page-0 grid, 48-item cap): when the embedded array has <48 items that is the exact, complete total (verified technique from the prior Home-Decor pass on this exact site). Only Home/c/home-bestsellers hit the 48-item cap; its true total (49) came from the rendered page text 'Showing 48 of 49' via WebFetch. This project is company-wide (no home-decor-only scope restriction in the brief), so Bestsellers listings from all departments (Home, Bedroom, Clothing, Candles & Fragrance, Beauty & Spa) were checked and included, not just home-decor items.
